subject.title: [Bug]: failed image attachment loads are silently dropped from the model prompt — model answers as if no image was sent

question: Where should OpenClaw surface failed native image loads: model-visible prompt markers, user/operator diagnostics, turn failure, or a combination?
rationale: The bug path is clear, but the durable contract affects model-visible wording, user-facing behavior, log level, path disclosure, and multiple caller surfaces.

options.title: Shared failure metadata
options.body: Return safe skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers render the same approved marker or diagnostic without full local paths.

options.title: Embedded prompt marker only
options.body: Insert a conservative model-visible marker in the embedded runner first and track CLI/harness parity separately.

options.title: Diagnostic-only notice
options.body: Warn the user or operator without modifying the model prompt, accepting that the model may still answer without the missing image.

recommendation.title: Shared failure metadata
recommendation.body: Return safe skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers render the same approved marker or diagnostic without full local paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest current-main history on the central image-loading and caller files.
